HediffDef.label: autonomy break
HediffDef.description: This individualist nanite mind has rejected dense collective consensus for a bounded period. The pawn remains physically compatible with the lattice and retains passive Pattern Archive continuity, but refuses active network assistance to its reconstruction processes until the break passes.

HediffDef.label: consensus deprivation
HediffDef.description: This collective-loyalist nanite mind has remained without compatible network peers long enough for its dependency on shared consensus to become disruptive. Reconstruction efficiency and learning remain impaired until the episode passes.
